1 · Intro

When to use it.

In Oracle HCM, one record feeds the next. A wrong value on a position or assignment does not stay put; it flows into pay, costing, and every report built on it.

Getting it right the first time is far cheaper than fixing it after payroll runs.

Use this whenYou are entering or changing any person, position, or assignment data and want to understand why each field matters.

2 · Walk through

Why every field matters.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Fixes after payroll runs become retro adjustments in a later payroll and may mean a late or incorrect paycheck.
  • Never reactivate an inactive position or repurpose one across worker types to save time.
  • Open item: confirm which data errors Vanderbilt sees most often and who to contact for corrections.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Start Here

Data integrity: bad data in, bad data out

Use when: You are entering or changing any person, position, or assignment data and want to understand why each field matters. · System: Overview

  1. Follow the chain from position to pay.
  2. Know that positions push values to assignments.
  3. Check dates as carefully as values.
  4. Remember costing follows the data.
  5. Confirm what the position does not set.
  6. Review before you submit.
    • Check: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, costing.

Watch-outs

  • Fixes after payroll runs become retro adjustments in a later payroll and may mean a late or incorrect paycheck.
  • Never reactivate an inactive position or repurpose one across worker types to save time.
  • Open item: confirm which data errors Vanderbilt sees most often and who to contact for corrections.
